name: citiesByQty
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    ci.id as id,
    ci.name as city_name,
    s.name as state_name,
    s.code as state_code,
    COUNT(c.id) as congregation_count
FROM 
    cities ci
LEFT JOIN congregations c ON c.city = ci.id
LEFT JOIN states s ON ci.state = s.id
GROUP BY 
    ci.id, ci.name, s.name, s.code
HAVING 
    COUNT(c.id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    congregation_count DESC, ci.name

name: congregationMeta
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.notes,
    c.denomination,
    c.clergy,
    c.flavor,
    c.contactName,
    c.contactEmail,
    c.contactUrl,
    c.visible,
    u.id as owner,
      json_object(
        'city', json_object('id', city.id, 'name', city.name, 'longitude', city.longitude, 'latitude', city.latitude),
        'state', json_object('id', state.id, 'name', state.name, 'code', state.code, 'longitude', state.longitude, 'latitude', state.latitude),
        'country', json_object('id', country.id, 'name', country.name, 'code', country.code, 'longitude', country.longitude, 'latitude', country.latitude)
    ) AS location,
    json_object(
        'id', a.id,
        'online_liveCaptions', a.online_liveCaptions,
        'online_automatedCaptions', a.online_automatedCaptions,
        'online_asl', a.online_asl,
        'inPerson_eva', a.inPerson_eva,
        'inPerson_asl', a.inPerson_asl,
        'inPerson_adaAll', a.inPerson_adaAll,
        'inPerson_adaSome', a.inPerson_adaSome,
        'other', a.other,
        'otherText', a.otherText
    ) AS accessibility,
    json_object(
        'id', f.id,
        'publicStatement', f.publicStatement,
        'clergyMember', f.clergyMember,
        'multipleClergyMembers', f.multipleClergyMembers,
        'other', f.other,
        'otherText', f.otherText,
        'flag', f.flag
    ) AS fit,
    json_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'email', r.email,
        'url', r.url,
        'registrationType', r.registrationType,
        'otherText', r.otherText
    ) AS registration,
    json_object(
        'id', h.id,
        'protocol', h.protocol,
        'otherText', h.otherText
    ) AS health,
    json_object(
      'id', sc.id,
      'localPolice', sc.localPolice,
      'privateSecurityArmed', sc.privateSecurityArmed,
      'privateSecurityUnarmed', sc.privateSecurityUnarmed,
      'clergyArmed', sc.clergyArmed,
      'congregantsArmed', sc.congregantsArmed,
      'noFirearms', sc.noFirearms
    ) as security,
    json_object(
        'id', sv.id,
        'inPerson', sv.inPerson,
        'hybrid', sv.hybrid,
        'onlineOnly', sv.onlineOnly,
        'offsite', sv.offsite,
        'other', sv.other,
        'otherText', sv.otherText
    ) AS services
FROM 
    congregations c
LEFT JOIN countries country ON c.country = country.id
LEFT JOIN states state ON c.state = state.id
LEFT JOIN cities city ON c.city = city.id
LEFT JOIN accessibility a ON c.id = a.congregation
LEFT JOIN fit f ON c.id = f.congregation
LEFT JOIN registration r ON c.id = r.congregation
LEFT JOIN health h ON c.id = h.congregation
LEFT JOIN services sv ON c.id = sv.congregation
LEFT JOIN security sc ON c.id = sc.congregation
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.congregation = c.id;

name: countriesByQty
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    co.id as id,
    co.name as country_name,
    co.code as country_code,
    co.flag as country_flag,
    COUNT(c.id) as congregation_count
FROM 
    countries co
LEFT JOIN congregations c ON c.country = co.id
GROUP BY 
    co.id, co.name, co.code, co.flag
HAVING 
    COUNT(c.id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    congregation_count DESC, co.name

name: statesByQty
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    s.id as id,
    s.name as state_name,
    s.code as state_code,
    co.name as country_name,
    COUNT(c.id) as congregation_count
FROM 
    states s
LEFT JOIN congregations c ON c.state = s.id
LEFT JOIN countries co ON s.country = co.id
GROUP BY 
    s.id, s.name, s.code, co.name
HAVING 
    COUNT(c.id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    congregation_count DESC, s.name

name: totalCountries
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    'countries_total' as id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.country) as total_countries
FROM 
    congregations c
WHERE 
    c.country IS NOT NULL

name: totalStates
viewQuery:
SELECT 
    'us_states_total' as id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.state) as total_us_states
FROM 
    congregations c
INNER JOIN states s ON c.state = s.id
INNER JOIN countries co ON s.country = co.id
WHERE 
    co.code = 'US'
